written: 2026-10-02, after arms A and B had finished and arm C's sets {0,2,4,6} and {0,2,...,10} had finished, with arm C's last set ({0,2,...,20}, 16 restarts) still running. WHAT HAS BEEN SEEN: the best score, the best overlap and the median overlap of every restart of arms A and B and of the two finished sets of arm C, by code size. No restart reached an overlap of 0.9 (arm A at most 0.40; arm B at most 0.67; arm C's two finished sets at most 0.51). Nothing about arm C's {0,2,...,20} set has been read.
status: AMENDMENT 2 to the training registration. It adds no prediction and changes no criterion. It fixes the details of rung 1 of the registered ladder (design.ladderIfNothingForms), which the registration left open, so that rung 1 can start the moment arm C's last set has ended without a formed restart.
instruction: The ladder is registered as an instruction (the user's standing instruction: if training does not produce the pattern for the range of orders considered, extend the range and continue until it is found). This amendment only fixes what the registration left unsaid for rung 1.
condition: Rung 1 is launched only if arm C's {0,2,...,20} set has ended with no restart at overlap >= 0.9. If it has formed, rung 1 is not run and the ladder is not climbed.

rung1.1a: ceiling 1.3, population 64, 100 generations, the contiguous orders 3, 4, 5 and 6 one after another (--dependency=afterany), 10 restarts each (0-9), folder data/boundaryHarmonicTraining1888Hold301DoubleStripesInteriorMinus60Minus5Population64/, --libraryDirs set to arm A's folder.
rung1.1b: the same at ceiling 2.0, folder data/boundaryHarmonicTraining1888Hold301DoubleStripesInteriorMinus60Minus5Ceiling2Population64/, --libraryDirs set to arm B's folder. Started at the same time as 1a.
rung1.libraryRule: the library folders are those of the same ceiling and of the same target only (arm A's for 1.3, arm B's for 2.0), as arm C's were. No folder of the face or the single stripe is used.
rung1.summaries: read with analyzeBoundaryHarmonicTraining11x11.py over the pilot folder and the population-64 folder of the same ceiling together, as the single stripe's Combined summaries were (tags Ceiling1p3Combined and Ceiling2Combined); the scoring script reads them in place of the Pilot summaries for the sizes they contain.

afterRung1: G1 and G2 are read on the finished rung before anything else is launched. If rung 1 forms, the ladder ends. If it does not, rungs 2 and 3 of design.ladderIfNothingForms follow, each with its own note giving its folders, restarts and library, committed before it launches.
reportingRules: Every rung is reported with its number of codes simulated. A rung that forms is reported with the route it belongs to.
